name: io.github.nickgeorgeseo/fieldtwin
title: fieldtwin
description: Local, stateful twins of the Jobber, Housecall Pro, and QuickBooks Online APIs, for agents and tests

environmentVariables.name: FIELDTWIN_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port the twin listens on. The MCP server starts a twin of its own, so pick another port if one already runs on 4010.

environmentVariables.name: FIELDTWIN_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The address the twin listens on. Keep the loopback address unless something else must reach the twin.

environmentVariables.name: FIELDTWIN_AUTH
environmentVariables.description: any-token accepts any Bearer token; oauth accepts only tokens from the twin's OAuth endpoints.

environmentVariables.name: FIELDTWIN_SEED
environmentVariables.description: Which fake business to generate: the same seed builds the same world.
